'''Szygar''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] competitor in the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. He was eliminated in the third day of competition and accused [[Armen Arandis]] of cheating. He pulled a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] on Arandis, though the dispute was resolved by event security and covert [[Alderaanian Resistance]] members.
